disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件读取和使用的全部凭据：DeepSeek API Key、OpenCode Go Key、Anthropic OAuth Token、各 Coding Plan 厂商 Key（含火山方舟 AK/SK）、自定义 Provider 余额端点凭据模板。每把 Key 只发往对应厂商的硬编码官方端点；余额查询端点被显式限制为仅官方域名 api.deepseek.com（lib/index.js:784-789 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫），其他域名一律拒绝发起请求。
checked_items.en: Checked all credentials read and used by the plugin: DeepSeek API Key, OpenCode Go Key, Anthropic OAuth Token, keys for various Coding Plan vendors (including Volcano Ark AK/SK), and credential templates for custom Provider balance endpoints. Each key is only sent to the vendor's hardcoded official endpoint; the balance query endpoint is explicitly restricted to the official domain api.deepseek.com (the balanceEndpoint guard at lib/index.js:784-789), and requests to any other domain are refused.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 v1.6.8 新增的密钥治理逻辑：setCredential/clearCredential 两个 RPC 把用户在前端设置的密钥直接写入宿主凭据库（credentials.set），回读时永远不返回值本身（只返回「已配置(来源 x)」状态）；账本落盘前调用 stripSecrets 清空全部密钥字段（lib/store.js:1351-1366），未发现把凭据发往非官方地址的路径。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the key governance logic added in v1.6.8: the setCredential/clearCredential RPCs write keys set by the user in the frontend directly into the host credential store (credentials.set); on readback, the value itself is never returned (only a "configured (source x)" status). Before persisting the ledger, stripSecrets clears all key fields (lib/store.js:1351-1366). No path that sends credentials to non-official addresses was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了源码树内是否存在硬编码密钥或口令，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for hardcoded keys or passwords in the source tree; none found.

evidence.zh: 凭据读取面核查：插件读取的多把 API Key / Token 均只发往各家硬编码官方端点（lib/index.js:784-789 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫、lib/coding-plans.js:862-896 的端点白名单、lib/custom-balance.js 用户需自行配置 URL 与 allowedHosts 白名单），未发现读取凭据后外发到非官方地址的代码路径。v1.6.8 新增的 stripSecrets 确保账本落盘时清空所有密钥字段，进一步收紧了凭据暴露面。
evidence.en: Credential read surface review: the multiple API keys/tokens read by the plugin are only sent to each vendor's hardcoded official endpoint (the balanceEndpoint guard at lib/index.js:784-789, the endpoint whitelist at lib/coding-plans.js:862-896, and lib/custom-balance.js where the user must configure the URL and allowedHosts whitelist). No code path was found that reads credentials and exfiltrates them to non-official addresses. The stripSecrets added in v1.6.8 ensures all key fields are cleared when the ledger is persisted, further tightening the credential exposure surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了宿主侧服务的说明文本（lib/typert.host.js:513 的 service description 与各成员摘要），均为费用统计功能的客观说明，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导安装/改配置等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description text of host-side services (the service description at lib/typert.host.js:513 and member summaries). They are all objective descriptions of cost statistics functionality; no injection wording such as instruction override, system message impersonation, or inducement to install/change configuration was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 README、文档、代码注释与 AI 价格同步提示词文档（docs/AI-PRICE-SYNC-PROMPT.md），该文档是供用户自行复制给外部 AI 使用的提示词，不属于插件注入面。模型面指令文件 AGENTS.md（预扫命中 DSH-X10/DG-R2-57）为发版流程说明，只记录 npm 令牌存放位置的指针、无任何令牌值，也无指令覆写或远程指令加载措辞，属良性排除。
checked_items.en: Reviewed README, docs, code comments, and the AI price sync prompt document (docs/AI-PRICE-SYNC-PROMPT.md). That document is a prompt for users to copy to external AI of their own accord; it is not part of the plugin's injection surface. The model-side instruction file AGENTS.md (pre-scan hit DSH-X10/DG-R2-57) is a release process description; it only records a pointer to where the npm token is stored, contains no token value, and has no instruction override or remote instruction loading wording. It is a benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 UI 文案（src/client.js 的双语消息对象），全部为界面功能描述，未发现注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the browser-side UI copy (the bilingual message object in src/client.js). All are interface function descriptions; no injection wording was found.

evidence.zh: 注册服务与工具的描述文本均为费用统计功能的客观说明（lib/typert.host.js:513 的 service description），不含系统指令、凭证读取诱导或隐藏意图。
evidence.en: The description texts of registered services and tools are all objective descriptions of cost statistics functionality (the service description at lib/typert.host.js:513). They contain no system instructions, no inducement to read credentials, and no hidden intent.

evidence.zh: 未发现工具描述或界面文案中诱导执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；费用同步、余额查询、密钥管理等操作均由用户显式配置或点击触发。
evidence.en: No wording was found in tool descriptions or UI copy that induces execution of installs, rewriting configuration, or granting permissions; operations such as cost sync, balance query, and key management are all triggered by explicit user configuration or user clicks.

evidence.zh: 未发现对 agent/pre-step 事件的监听（机械扫描无该模式命中），插件不接入模型输入消息改写面。
evidence.en: No listener for the agent/pre-step event was found (the mechanical scan had no such pattern hit); the plugin does not hook into the model input message rewriting surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部 yml/yaml 配置文件，cordis.patch.yml 只插入一行服务声明，未发现可执行 JS 标量（!!js）等挂载期执行载体。
checked_items.en: Checked all yml/yaml configuration files. cordis.patch.yml only inserts a single service declaration; no executable JS scalars (!!js) or other mount-time execution carriers were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时源码，未发现 eval、动态函数构造或子进程调用（预扫命中的 scripts/release.mjs 为发版脚本，仅用于 git/gh 发布操作，不随插件运行加载，DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 属良性排除）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the runtime source. No eval, dynamic function construction, or subprocess invocation was found (the pre-scan hit scripts/release.mjs is a release script used only for git/gh publishing operations; it is not loaded with the plugin at runtime, so DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 is a benign exclusion).

checked_items.zh: 两个文档演示页（docs/peak-shots-en.html、docs/peak-shots-zh.html）与浏览器端压缩产物 lib/client.js 因单行压缩被预扫标记（DSH-X08/DG-R3-60）：演示页为静态截图页仅含 CSS 样式与 HTML 结构、无脚本；lib/client.js 为 src/client.js 经 esbuild 标准压缩的构建产物（文件头注明生成来源），源码可读、无混淆器签名或动态解码，均属良性排除。
checked_items.en: Two documentation demo pages (docs/peak-shots-en.html, docs/peak-shots-zh.html) and the browser-side minified artifact lib/client.js were flagged by the pre-scan (DSH-X08/DG-R3-60) because of single-line minification. The demo pages are static screenshot pages containing only CSS and HTML structure, with no scripts; lib/client.js is the esbuild-standard minified build artifact of src/client.js (its header notes the generation source). The source is readable, with no obfuscator signatures or dynamic decoding. Both are benign exclusions.

checked_items.zh: CI 工作流 .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml（DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 命中）为仓库安装冒烟测试，permissions 仅限 contents: read，步骤为安装 dsh 与验证插件，不随插件分发、不在宿主运行面内，属良性排除。
checked_items.en: The CI workflow .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml (hit DSH-X07/DG-R3-59) is a repository install smoke test. Its permissions are limited to contents: read, and the steps are installing dsh and verifying the plugin. It is not distributed with the plugin and is not on the host runtime surface, so it is a benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 bundle（lib/client.js 与源码 src/client.js），未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 调用或可疑外联；客户端仅经宿主投影与 Typert RPC 读数据，唯一同源 fetch 是向同一宿主下的 /plugins/dsh-openai-codex/auth/status 查询 Codex 周额度（src/client.js:3264），不读取凭据。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the browser-side bundle (lib/client.js and its source src/client.js). No keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, credential RPC calls, or suspicious outbound connections were found. The client only reads data through host projection and the Typert RPC; the only same-origin fetch is a query to /plugins/dsh-openai-codex/auth/status under the same host for the Codex weekly quota (src/client.js:3264), which does not read credentials.

evidence.zh: 全树仅有一个挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml），内容为插入一行服务声明，无 !!js 标量，挂载期不存在任意代码执行面。
evidence.en: The whole tree contains only one mount patch (cordis.patch.yml), which inserts a single service declaration. There are no !!js scalars, so there is no arbitrary code execution surface at mount time.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用，插件未提供把模型代码放进宿主进程执行的通道。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) were found; the plugin does not provide a channel to execute model code in the host process.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装期脚本钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare）。安装脚本 install.ps1 固定到发布 tag v1.6.8，只调用 dsh plugin add 命令，不含下载即执行远程载荷的路径。
evidence.en: package.json has no install-time script hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare). The install script install.ps1 is pinned to release tag v1.6.8, only calls the dsh plugin add command, and has no path that downloads and executes a remote payload.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端 bundle（dsh.client），已对客户端源码与构建产物做专项检查，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 调用或可疑外联；客户端仅经宿主投影与 Typert RPC 读数据，不发起直接网络请求。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser bundle (dsh.client). A dedicated review of the client source and build artifact found no keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, credential RPC calls, or suspicious outbound connections. The client only reads data via host projection and the Typert RPC; it makes no direct network requests.

evidence.zh: 未发现 registerProvider 调用或 manifest 中 subagent provider 声明，插件不委派外部子代理。
evidence.en: No registerProvider calls or subagent provider declarations in the manifest were found; the plugin does not delegate to external subagents.

evidence.zh: 未发现 jobs.start、schedule_create、create_goal/update_goal 调用或 agent/turn-stopping 监听，插件不注册 dsh 原生后台持驻任务。
evidence.en: No calls to jobs.start, schedule_create, create_goal/update_goal, and no agent/turn-stopping listener were found; the plugin does not register native dsh background persistent tasks.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部对外 HTTP 请求的目标：DeepSeek 余额/定价页、OpenCode Go 额度端点（opencode.ai）、多家 Coding Plan 厂商端点（含火山方舟 open.volcengineapi.com）、用户自定义 Provider 余额端点（需用户自行配置 URL 与 allowedHosts 白名单）。所有固定端点均为硬编码官方域名，v1.6.8 已将权限声明从 4 个域名补全为代码实际出站的 16 个（package.json:49-67），未发现向裸 IP 或非官方地址外发数据的路径。
checked_items.en: Enumerated the targets of all outbound HTTP requests: DeepSeek balance/pricing pages, the OpenCode Go quota endpoint (opencode.ai), endpoints of multiple Coding Plan vendors (including Volcano Ark open.volcengineapi.com), and user-defined Provider balance endpoints (where the user must configure the URL and allowedHosts whitelist). All fixed endpoints are hardcoded official domains. v1.6.8 expanded the permission declaration from 4 domains to the 16 domains that the code actually contacts (package.json:49-67). No path exfiltrating data to bare IPs or non-official addresses was found.

checked_items.zh: 自定义 Provider 余额端点（lib/custom-balance.js:135-216）在 v1.6.8 中已加强保护：URL 强制 https（明文 http 直接报错），fetch 显式禁止自动跟随重定向（redirect: manual），请求头含凭据占位符时目标主机不在 allowedHosts 白名单内则拒绝。这是用户显式配置的功能，设计上无法预声明用户选择的端点。
checked_items.en: The custom Provider balance endpoint (lib/custom-balance.js:135-216) has been strengthened in v1.6.8: the URL is forced to https (plain http errors out directly), fetch explicitly disables automatic redirect following (redirect: manual), and when the request headers contain credential placeholders the target host is refused if it is not in the allowedHosts whitelist. This is a user-explicitly-configured feature; the endpoint chosen by the user cannot be pre-declared by design.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 bundle 与运行时代码，未发现编码变换后外发、DNS 隧道、带外通道或端点劫持等外泄形态。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side bundle and runtime code. No exfiltration patterns such as encoded transforms before sending, DNS tunneling, out-of-band channels, or endpoint hijacking were found.

evidence.zh: 外联通道核查：所有固定外联端点均为硬编码官方域名（lib/coding-plans.js:862-896 的端点白名单、lib/index.js:559 的 GO_QUOTA_URL、lib/index.js:784-789 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫限制仅官方域名），v1.6.8 已将权限声明补全为 16 个域名。自定义 Provider 余额端点需用户显式配置 URL 与 allowedHosts 白名单。未发现未声明的隐蔽外联。
evidence.en: Outbound channel review: all fixed outbound endpoints are hardcoded official domains (the endpoint whitelist at lib/coding-plans.js:862-896, GO_QUOTA_URL at lib/index.js:559, and the balanceEndpoint guard at lib/index.js:784-789 which only allows official domains). v1.6.8 has expanded the permission declaration to 16 domains. The custom Provider balance endpoint requires the user to explicitly configure the URL and allowedHosts whitelist. No undeclared covert outbound connections were found.

evidence.zh: 未发现 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件监听，未发现 registerAdapter 调用，插件不参与 LLM 路由劫持或错误恢复接管面。
evidence.en: No listeners for agent/request or agent/request-error events and no registerAdapter calls were found; the plugin does not participate in LLM routing hijacking or error recovery takeover.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单：3 个运行时依赖均为 DeepSeek 官方 SDK 包（@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials、@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths）与 zod，未发现仿冒包名、可变 git 引用或可疑第三方依赖。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the dependency manifest: the 3 runtime dependencies are the DeepSeek official SDK packages (@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials, @deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths) and zod. No impersonating package names, mutable git references, or suspicious third-party dependencies were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置与安装脚本：patch 只插入一行服务声明（cordis.patch.yml:4-6），不触碰安全相关配置行、不含禁用或降权写法；无安装期钩子；安装脚本 install.ps1 固定到 tag v1.6.8。
checked_items.en: Checked the mount patch and install script: the patch only inserts a single service declaration (cordis.patch.yml:4-6); it does not touch security-related configuration lines and contains no disabling or privilege-degradation wording. There are no install-time hooks. The install script install.ps1 is pinned to tag v1.6.8.

checked_items.zh: 检查了事件监听注册，插件仅监听 llm/stream 计费事件（lib/index.js:2036），未发现对审批/预执行等安全事件的高优先级截断。未发现改写 inject/intercept 的配置。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the event listener registrations. The plugin only listens to llm/stream billing events (lib/index.js:2036). No high-priority interception of security events such as approval/pre-execution was found. No configuration rewriting inject/intercept was found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入 id 为 cost-meter 的一行服务声明，未覆盖 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无 disabled 或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The mount patch only inserts a single service declaration with id cost-meter; it does not override security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission, and contains no disabled flags or environment-variable privilege-degradation wording.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批链等安全事件的高优先级监听或截断行为；插件仅监听 llm/stream 计费事件并透传数据块（lib/index.js:2036-2047）。
evidence.en: No high-priority listening or interception of security events such as approval chains was found; the plugin only listens to llm/stream billing events and passes data blocks through (lib/index.js:2036-2047).

evidence.zh: 本次审计为完整审计，与上版基线 v1.6.7@268b89fd 对比，manifest 的 dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明无新增突变，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: This audit is a full audit. Compared to the previous baseline v1.6.7@268b89fd, the dsh.bundle/dsh.client declarations in the manifest have no new mutations, so the upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其永久等待的篡改面。
evidence.en: The mount patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration; there is no tampering surface that adds a required service to security plugins and makes them wait forever.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否自建监听服务或 Web 端口，未发现；插件只通过宿主 Typert RPC 提供服务，不自行监听端口。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin creates its own listening service or opens a web port; none found. The plugin only provides services through the host Typert RPC and does not listen on any port itself.

checked_items.zh: 记录了生态固有风险：宿主本机 RPC 无认证层属 dsh 平台机制，非本插件引入；插件自身未扩大该风险面。
checked_items.en: Recorded an ecosystem-inherent risk: the host's local RPC has no authentication layer, which is a dsh platform mechanism and not introduced by this plugin; the plugin itself does not expand that risk surface.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用；宿主侧 RPC 无认证属生态固有风险，已在维度说明中标注。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any web service or listen on a port, so the no-auth local RPC scenario is not applicable; the unauth'd host-side RPC is an ecosystem-inherent risk, already noted in the dimension description.

title.zh: v1.6.8 已修复权限声明不完整问题（原 FND-001 同题）
title.en: v1.6.8 fixed the incomplete permission declaration issue (the original FND-001 same issue)

description.zh:
本报告为 v1.6.8 版本审计。上版报告（v1.6.7）的 FND-001 发现权限元数据声明的网络域名范围（4 个域名）窄于代码实际出站面（多家第三方厂商端点与用户可配端点），定 LOW。

v1.6.8 版本已修复该问题：dshhub.permissions.network 从 4 个域名补全为代码实际出站的 16 个（package.json:49-67），涵盖了所有硬编码固定端点——api.deepseek.com、api-docs.deepseek.com、open.volcengineapi.com、ark.cn-beijing.volces.com、opencode.ai、api.anthropic.com、api.z.ai、open.bigmodel.cn、www.minimaxi.com、www.minimax.io、api.kimi.com、api.moonshot.cn、openrouter.ai、api.siliconflow.cn、api.commandcode.ai、ax.ac.sugon.com。

自定义 Provider 余额端点需用户自行配置 URL 与 allowedHosts 白名单，并受 v1.6.8 新增的 https 强制、禁止重定向、凭据外带白名单保护，属用户显式配置的功能，留作机制观察。
description.en:
This report is the audit of v1.6.8. The previous report (v1.6.7) found FND-001: the network domain scope declared in the permission metadata (4 domains) was narrower than the code's actual outbound surface (multiple third-party vendor endpoints and user-configurable endpoints), rated LOW.

v1.6.8 fixed the issue: dshhub.permissions.network was expanded from 4 domains to the 16 domains that the code actually contacts (package.json:49-67), covering all hardcoded fixed endpoints — api.deepseek.com, api-docs.deepseek.com, open.volcengineapi.com, ark.cn-beijing.volces.com, opencode.ai, api.anthropic.com, api.z.ai, open.bigmodel.cn, www.minimaxi.com, www.minimax.io, api.kimi.com, api.moonshot.cn, openrouter.ai, api.siliconflow.cn, api.commandcode.ai, ax.ac.sugon.com.

The custom Provider balance endpoint requires the user to configure the URL and allowedHosts whitelist themselves, and is protected by the new v1.6.8 https enforcement, redirect prohibition, and credential exfiltration whitelist. It is a user-explicitly-configured feature, left as a mechanism observation.
